---
title: App data
description: Use the Data view to browse tables and rows.
sidebar:
  order: 12
---

When the project includes a web app, the right-side switch includes **Data**. It lists the tables the app uses. You can browse rows, add rows, and edit them.

Treat Data as the business data your app is using — not a separate database product you have to provision. Tables appear as the app is built. After a turn that creates tables, open **Data** to see them.

Projects without a web app do not show the Data switch.
